No exemption: `GENERATED_SURFACE_EXCEPTIONS` lifts a PATH off the register and moves the size not at all — pinned. `dispatch-gates.mjs` prints the reading beside the tier verdict on every run (worktree numstat + untracked files; an explicit path list prints NOT MEASURED, never a silent 「under」).
- **The rule text.** SKILL.md :608 「改动 >5000 行(含生成物)同换终局四件套,⛔ 无事实层例外;读数 = PR additions+deletions。」 beside the four-piece-terminal trigger; landing-operations.md :26 folded to 「转 ready/入队前跑 `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr N`:受管面照两层;>5000 行(含生成物)照规则层。」. **The SKILL.md ceiling rises 812 → 813** under the ratchet's own maintainer exit, the ruling quoted verbatim in the CEILINGS entry, with the fold measured impossible (the trigger line is 118 B against the 120-byte cap; the shortest self-contained rule is 111 B; 0 of 598 adjacent bullet pairs merge under the cap, smallest 123 B; deleting a ruled clause is refused on the state-machine precedent). A ceiling raise is on the manual floor; here the rule is the maintainer's own and the raise is presented to the maintainer in the same PR — approving the PR approves the raise; the 速读 says so in one line. The dev's offered alternative (drop the SKILL.md hunk + ratchet entry, file the line behind #18903) is declined: the rule belongs where the terminal is triggered, now.
- **Seat re-measure on a scratch worktree at this head**: `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 18971` → `⛔ HUMAN MERGE — 238429 changed line(s) (+238310 / -119) > 5000`, exit 3 (on `main`: NOT governed, exit 0 — the exact hole the ruling closes); `--pr 19026` → NOT governed, exit 0, size 713 under; `--pr 19021` → GOVERNED by path, exit 3, `size: 480 … ≤ 5000`; `--test` together with `--pr` refused as two file lists (by design); `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` on the worktree prints `Changed lines — 724 (+692 / -32; generated files INCLUDED) vs the human-merge threshold 5000: under`; ratchet ✓ (813 / 813, 69 / 69); `check-skill-id-lint` ✓ 27 files; `--pair 19033` exit 0. **在真 PR 上的读数**:PR #18971(+238,310 / −119)—— 旧版本判「不受管,照常入队」;这个版本判「HUMAN MERGE,23.8 万行 > 5000」。今天其他 PR(最大 +692)全部「under」。

**⚠️ 请您看一眼的一件事**:SKILL.md 满额 812 行,这一行折不进任何现有行(dev 量了 598 对相邻行,最小合并后 123 字节 > 120 上限;删已裁条款按先例不允许),所以它把 SKILL.md 的行数上限从 **812 抬到 813**,并把您的原话记在棘轮表里。抬上限按规则要人裁 —— **您批准这个 PR 即视为批准这次抬升**。

**它还没盖住的两处,已立卡**:合并队列的守卫仍只看路径(#:席位若跳过前置检查直接入队,超大 PR 仍会合进去 —— 更急);AGENTS.md §7 还写着「两类 PR 不能凭绿灯合入」,现在是三类(#)。

**验收**:复核记录 5730219787(PASS)、ACCEPT 5730220167;门禁自测 328 → 369、派发工具自测 1849 → 1862;派生门禁 42 / 42 绿;CI 在跑,截至 12:47Z 无红。
